reviewFixes: Removed nondeterministic global run counter from authoritative identifiers.
Collision terminals now contain final checksum evidence.
Fully trapped fallback returns no unvalidated agent action; runtime applies deterministic straight-line terminal resolution.
Snapshot envelope preserves next semantic event sequence across restore.
knownLimits: The Phase 1 fallback policy is intentionally minimal and all large-profile corpus runs reached their technical tick cap rather than a game terminal.

Vitest/fast-check could not be installed in the isolated runtime; R1 verification uses TypeScript plus Node's built-in test runner and deterministic property loops. Phase 2 should port the same behavioral corpus to the planned test stack when dependency installation is available.
No renderer, provider adapter, persistence service, audience interaction, long soak, or production deployment is part of R1.
